title: The Ancestor Core
text: A relic power source from the age of the first Leagues. The one found on Kethra's Anvil was still running after ten thousand years.

title: Warboss Skragnak
text: The Warboss whose Orks raided the Anvil. With Gitzbolt's new weapon behind him, every Ork in the Reach wants to fight under his banner.

title: The muster at Skrapfang Rock
text: Hundreds of Ork ships gathering around a cratered moon, waiting for Skragnak to point them at Hold Durnvar.

title: Gitzbolt's weapon
text: A super-weapon too hungry for any Ork reactor. The Ancestor Core is the heart it was missing.
